name: quote
title: DRAFT product quote
for_each: select id,name from quotes order by name

sections.title: Customer and scope
sections.note: Draft for review. Not an invoice. No acceptance or dispatch is performed.

sections.title: Quoted items
sections.sql: select l.sku,l.product,l.quantity,l.discount_bps,b.currency,l.unit_cents,l.net_cents from line_totals l join quotes q on q.id=l.quote_id join pricebooks b on b.id=q.pricebook_id where l.quote_id=$1 order by l.sku

sections.title: Total including recorded tax
sections.sql: select currency,net_cents,tax_cents,total_cents from quote_totals where id=$1

name: approval-brief
title: Internal quote approval brief
for_each: select id,name from quotes order by name

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where quote_id=$1

sections.title: Approval history
sections.sql: select revision,actor,reason,created_at from approvals where quote_id=$1 order by created_at
